description:
Purpose: Request for Information – Sources Sought, The US Army Communications-Electronic Command (CECOM) is conducting a Market Survey to identify potential sources with the capability to provide maintenance support for the AN/USC-28(V) Satellite Communication Sets (SCS) and the Charon Merged Emulator.

The intent of this RFI is to gauge industry capabilities, and relevant experience to support the AN/USC-28(V) Satellite Communication Sets (SCS) and the Charon Merged Emulator.

The scope of this requirement includes, but is not limited to:

• Depot-level repair and overhaul of Line Replaceable Units (LRUs), Shop Replaceable Units (SRUs), and end-items for both Airborne and Ground-based systems.

• Providing Field Maintenance Technician (FMT) support.

• Testing, inspection, and certification of equipment.
